title: CatFood Compass current manufacturer nutrition layer
policy: Additive provenance layer only. Manufacturer observations never overwrite Pierson/FDSG records and are not automatically substituted into profile filtering when nutrient bases differ.

brand_sources.notes: Current ACANA wet-cat product pages publish GA, calculated ME, and Typical Analysis values for phosphorus, calcium, magnesium and ash.
Current ORIJEN wet-cat product pages publish GA, calculated ME, and Typical Analysis mineral values.
RAWZ product pages expose unusually rich Typical Analysis tables and explain that values are averages from ingredient databases and actual lab reports.
Young Again current product pages include a dedicated Dry Matter Analysis and key-mineral table.
Manufacturer kibble chart supplies dry-weight and as-is nutrient values. Manufacturer FAQ notes that some reported percentages may be estimates.
Current product pages publish Average Nutrient & Caloric Content, including dry-matter carbohydrate/NFE and minerals for many formulas.
Current product pages provide GA, selected minerals, and calculated ME. These are not treated as Typical Nutrient Analysis.
Official ZIWI Typical Analysis covers current cat Air-Dried, Steam & Dried, and canned recipes. This release links 15 exact catalog foods and preserves manufacturer bases separately.

Current Wx product pages link Weruva’s lab-analysis nutrition sheet. This release links all five Wx canned formulas present in CatFood Compass and preserves negative calculated carbohydrate values exactly as published.
Official 2026 Nutrition Reference Guide publishes Average Nutrient Content on per-100-kcal, as-is, dry-matter and %ME bases. This release links 12 exact current wet-cat products.

Current U.S. product pages were linked for the three N&D Quinoa Functional wet-cat formulas represented in CatFood Compass. Current pages expose GA and calculated ME; no unreported carbohydrate values are inferred.

Current U.S. product pages expose GA and calculated energy, but several CatFood Compass source names are legacy names or veterinary formulas. Exact current-product reconciliation is being kept conservative rather than forcing mappings.

Current manufacturer product pages were linked for all eight Câté/Minced formulas represented in CatFood Compass. This pass captures product-page GA and calories and leaves richer linked nutrient profiles for later structured extraction.

Current Purina product pages were linked to the 12 Classic Paté recipes represented by verified Fancy Feast reconciliation records. Fifteen CatFood Compass source rows are linked because three current recipes occur in both Pierson and FDSG source datasets. GA is captured only where directly verified; missing GA is left absent rather than inferred.
